name: version
meaning: 'V2.6'. Load_WAR prefix-compares it with sprintf('V%u.%u', 2, 6), temporarily NUL-ing +8. The same magic BsFile_Open validates, which is why Load_WarMeshes can open the WAR as a BsFile.

name: clearR
meaning: red of the level clear/fog colour. Load_DAVnWAR builds (r>>1)<<16 | (g>>1)<<8 | (b>>1) and passes it to PolyBatcher_SetClearColor and Frustrum_SetFogColor.

name: clearG
meaning: green of the clear/fog colour (halved at use)

name: clearB
meaning: blue of the clear/fog colour (halved at use)

name: resourceCount
meaning: number of u32 entries in the table at +0x10; the loop bound of Load_WAR, Load_WarMeshes and every Load_DAVnWAR pass
